# Declaration of authorship {.unnumbered}

**Replace this text with the declaration your examination office requires,
word for word.** You will find the current wording on your examination
office's forms (Prüfungsamt) or in your programme's examination regulations
(Prüfungsordnung). It typically confirms that you wrote the thesis yourself, used
only the sources and aids you name, and have not submitted it for another
examination; many universities now also ask you to state whether and how you
used AI tools.
